watchtower.png.name: Watchtower
watchtower.png.description: A perimeter lookout tower: a sandbagged platform on legs, cabin, searchlight, ladder.

saluting-base.png.name: Saluting base
saluting-base.png.description: The low reviewing dais at the head of the parade square.

flag-mast.png.name: Flag mast
flag-mast.png.description: A tall flag mast and plain pennant, with its long shadow.

parade-line.png.name: Parade line
parade-line.png.description: A painted line along the middle of its row; runs join end to end.

parade-corner.png.name: Parade corner
parade-corner.png.description: The painted border's corner: lines along the middle of its north row and west column, open to the south and east.

parade-ranks.png.name: Parade ranks
parade-ranks.png.description: A dashed rank line marking where a file stands; runs join end to end.

parade-centre.png.name: Parade centre
parade-centre.png.description: The square's painted centre mark: a cross in a ring.

parked-tank.png.name: Parked tank
parked-tank.png.description: A Hegemony medium tank parked in the vehicle park, turret and gun forward (west).

parked-apc-army.png.name: Parked APC
parked-apc-army.png.description: An army APC parked in the vehicle park, nose and turret forward (west).

antenna-mast.png.name: Antenna mast
antenna-mast.png.description: A tall guyed radio mast: base plate, three guy wires to anchors, its long thin shadow.

medical-marker.png.name: Medical marker
medical-marker.png.description: A painted panel by the medical post: a plain white cross on a green square, worn. A floor decal; blocks nothing.

uplink-dish.png.name: Uplink dish
uplink-dish.png.description: A satellite uplink dish seen from above, tilted up to the north-west on its hidden pedestal, its feed horn on struts; stands on the dish compound's pad.

radar-tower-lattice.png.name: Radar tower
radar-tower-lattice.png.description: A tall steel lattice tower: splayed feet, bracing, the head platform and its search-radar bar, a long shadow.

fuel-tank-vertical.png.name: Vertical fuel tank
fuel-tank-vertical.png.description: A vertical fuel storage tank's round roof: rim walkway rail, vent, hatch, the ladder's head.

exhaust-stack.png.name: Exhaust stack
exhaust-stack.png.description: A generator exhaust stack with its rain cap, stood against the generator house's back wall.

radiator-skid.png.name: Radiator skid
radiator-skid.png.description: A radiator and day-tank skid: two fans and a small tank.

earth-bund-h.png.name: Earth bund
earth-bund-h.png.description: A knee-high bank of packed earth, running east-west; pieces join into the tank farm's bund ring.

earth-bund-v.png.name: Earth bund
earth-bund-v.png.description: A knee-high bank of packed earth, running north-south; pieces join into the tank farm's bund ring.

earth-bund-corner-nw.png.name: Earth bund
earth-bund-corner-nw.png.description: A knee-high bank of packed earth, the ring's north-west corner; pieces join into the tank farm's bund ring.

earth-bund-corner-ne.png.name: Earth bund
earth-bund-corner-ne.png.description: A knee-high bank of packed earth, the ring's north-east corner; pieces join into the tank farm's bund ring.

earth-bund-corner-sw.png.name: Earth bund
earth-bund-corner-sw.png.description: A knee-high bank of packed earth, the ring's south-west corner; pieces join into the tank farm's bund ring.

earth-bund-corner-se.png.name: Earth bund
earth-bund-corner-se.png.description: A knee-high bank of packed earth, the ring's south-east corner; pieces join into the tank farm's bund ring.

parked-ambulance.png.name: Parked ambulance
parked-ambulance.png.description: An olive field ambulance parked at the medical post, nose west, a white cross on a green roof panel.

workshop-gantry.png.name: Workshop gantry
workshop-gantry.png.description: An A-frame gantry crane over a vehicle bay: an engine block hung under its hoist, a tool bench along its north side.

tent-khaki.png.name: Khaki tent
tent-khaki.png.description: A khaki ridge tent, ridge east-west, door flap east, guy ropes to pegs.
